headline: MIL @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 4.23 at ATL 4.06, with a projected total of 8.29. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: MIL moved -0.68 runs while ATL moved +0.09, changing the projected margin by -0.77 runs. The projected total fell -0.61, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Chris Sale has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, Christian Yelich, Michael Harris II, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Mateo, David Hamilton because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
